**Test image observations:**
- Mango leaf with a diffuse grayish-white/dusty coating covering most of the upper surface
- Scattered small dark spots throughout
- No distinct lesions, galls, or raised structures — purely a surface coating

**Comparison with reference images:**
- The Sooty Mould reference (bottom-right panel especially) shows a grayish-black superficial encrustation on mango leaves — matching the test image's uniform surface coating pattern
- Powdery Mildew would appear more distinctly white and powdery; Anthracnose would show sunken dark lesions; Gall Midge shows round blister galls

The test leaf shows a superficial coating consistent with sooty mould growing on honeydew deposits — not lesion-based disease.
